battle.name: 狼尾灘之戰
battle.brief: 開皇八年十二月，隋行軍元帥楊素率舟師自永安溯流，軍至三峽流頭灘，陳將戚欣以青龍戰船百餘艘、屯兵數千守狼尾灘。楊素以夜掩之，率黃龍數千艘銜枚而下，南岸步卒與北岸甲騎遲明合擊，戚欣敗走，三峽門戶洞開。卡面羅馬短劍不在此戰場，它標示同代短兵刺擊技術，與隋軍環首刀相近。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 開皇八年冬，隋文帝楊堅大舉伐陳，分八道進兵：晉王楊廣為行軍元帥總領東路，取採石、逼近建康；韓擒虎率精兵趨廬州；賀若弼、高熲佐廣節制東路，蘇綽掌度支以供軍食。狼尾灘之戰屬西線，即楊素一路。楊素以行軍元帥領舟師，自永安溯流趣三峽，並在永安預造五牙、黃龍等大艦，專取荊州方向。陳朝以建康為都，江防分而無統：荊州刺史陳慧紀當江陵一線，狼尾灘由陳將戚欣以青龍戰船百餘艘、屯兵數千人守之，岐亭有南康內史呂仲肅屯兵綴鐵鎖橫江，建康則由陳後主陳叔寶與大將蕭摩訶坐鎮。隋為攻勢，陳為守勢；陳倚險分守，隋以大艦集群與夜渡奇襲取主動。兩軍交戰形態是水陸銜接：隋舟師逆水而上，以夜掩奪灘，再以步騎自南北兩岸合擊。
countriesEn: In the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang, Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, launched a great campaign against the Chen, advancing in eight columns. The Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, was made supreme commander of the eastern route, taking Caishi and closing on Jiankang; Han Qinhu led picked troops against Luzhou; He Ruobi and Gao Jiong assisted Guang in directing the eastern army, while Su Cuo controlled the treasury accounts and saw to the army's food. The battle of Langbi belonged to the western route, the column of Yang Su. Yang Su, as supreme commander, led the flotilla up the river from Yong'an toward the Three Gorges, and had already built great warships there, the Wuya and the Huanglong, for the approach on Jingzhou. The Chen made Jiankang their capital, but their river defence was divided and without a single hand: the Inspector of Jingzhou, Chen Huiji, held the Jiangling line; the beach at Langbi was guarded by the Chen general Qi Xin with more than a hundred Azure Dragon warships and several thousand men; at Qiting the Administrator of Nankang, Lü Zhongsu, posted troops that chained three iron bars across the river; and at Jiankang sat the Chen ruler, Chen Shubao, with the great commander Xiao Mohe. The Sui were on the offensive, the Chen on the defensive: the Chen held strong points in sections, the Sui sought the initiative with massed great ships and a night crossing. The two sides therefore met in a joining of water and land, the Sui flotilla pushing up against the current, seizing the beach by night, and then striking together with infantry and cavalry from both banks.
people: 楊素是本役主導者。隋文帝圖江表時，他屢進取陳之策，被拜信州總管、遣往永安造艦；開皇八年大舉伐陳時拜行軍元帥，領舟師趣三峽。軍至流頭灘，諸將見狼尾灘地險而患之，楊素斷言「勝負大計，在此一舉」，說明若晝日下船，敵先見我、灘流迅激而制不由人，遂定夜掩之策：親率黃龍數千艘銜枚而下，遣開府王長襲引步卒自南岸攻敵別柵，命大將軍劉仁恩率甲騎趣白沙北岸、遲明而至，天明合擊而戚欣敗走。陳將戚欣守灘有功卻力不敵，率眾遁走，所部盡為所俘。陳將呂仲肅隨後屯岐亭、綴鐵鎖三條橫截江面，仍為楊素與劉仁恩登陸攻柵所破，僅以身免。隋方主持全局者是隋文帝楊堅，總攬方略、兵額與糧械；行軍長史高熲與掌度支的蘇綽分掌籌策與供應，東路與西路互為表裡。陳方荊州刺史陳慧紀居江陵，負責上游各州郡的徵發與防守；狼尾灘的戚欣只是分守一段的主將，並無調動全軍之權，故一敗而荊州線震動。陳朝則由陳後主主持，屢拒蕭摩訶出戰之請，上下離心。
peopleEn: Yang Su was the man who shaped this battle. While the Sui ruler was laying his plans against the Jiangnan, Yang Su pressed his own schemes for taking the Chen, was appointed Administrator of Xinzhou and sent to Yong'an to build his ships; and when the great campaign of the eighth year of Kaihuang began he was made supreme commander, leading the flotilla up toward the Three Gorges. When the army reached Liutou beach, the generals were troubled by the difficulty of the ground at Langbi, and Yang Su declared that the whole question of victory and defeat turned on this single stroke: if they disembarked by day the enemy would see them first, the current at the beach ran so swiftly that nothing could be controlled, and they would lose their advantage. So he chose to cover the movement by night. He led several thousand Huanglong ships personally down the river with the crews gagged, sent the Held Secretary Wang Changxiang with infantry from the south bank to strike the enemy's separate camp, and ordered the General Liu Renen to take armoured cavalry by the north bank at Baisha, arriving at daybreak; the two wings fell on the enemy together and Qi Xin was routed. The Chen general Qi Xin, who had held the beach, could not stand the pressure and fled with his men, all of whom were taken prisoner. The Chen general Lü Zhongsu then posted at Qiting and chained three iron bars across the river, but he too was broken when Yang Su and Liu Renen landed and attacked the camp, escaping with his life alone. On the Sui side the overall direction was in the hands of Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, who managed the plans, the troop allotments and the supplies; on the eastern route Gao Jiong and Su Cuo served as counsellors. In the Chen, the Inspector of Jingzhou, Chen Huiji, sat at Jiangling responsible for raising men and holding the upper river; and the court was run by the Chen ruler, who again and again refused Xiao Mohe's request to fight, and command and country were pulling apart.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬短劍並未出現在狼尾灘。gladius 約西元前100年前後定型：雙刃、葉形尖，劍身狹長約五十至六十公分，有護手與柄頭，通體近一公斤，重心偏前；用法不是揮砍而是刺突，須貼在大盾弧面之內出手，並以盾緣磕擊、勾拉敵刃，標槍耗盡後才充最後手段。東羅馬與拜占庭軍隊一直沿用此類短劍，到西元500年前後才逐步被長劍取代，故它與588年在時間上重疊。狼尾灘真正決定勝負的兵器是船。楊素在永安所造五牙大艦，上起樓五層、高百餘尺，左右前後置六拍竿、並高五十尺，容戰士八百人，旗幟加於上；次曰黃龍，置兵百人，其餘平乘、舴艋等各有差等。五牙左右前後置六拍竿、高五十尺，是狹江中撞擊敵艦與驅趕阻船的器械，隋軍後來即以柏檣撞碎陳艦十餘艘，大艦的作用在撞與嚇。陳方以青龍百餘艘拒灘。岸戰兵器則是隋軍的環首刀、長矛與配馬鎧的甲騎，陳軍以弩箭、長槊守柵；隋軍後來以柏檣撞擊陳舟，橫江鐵索也靠岸上步騎先拔柵寨、再解鎖，可見短兵只出現在柵欄之間的零星肉搏，並非戰局樞紐。
kitsEn: The Roman short sword on the card never appeared at Langbi. The gladius was fixed in form around 100 BC: double edged, with a leaf-shaped point, a blade some fifty to sixty centimetres long, a guard and a pommel, the whole weapon close to a kilogram in weight and balanced forward. It was not swung but thrust, and the blow had to be delivered from inside the curve of the large shield, the shield rim being used to strike, hook and pull aside the enemy's blade, the sword normally serving only as a last resort once the throwing javelins were spent. Eastern Roman and Byzantine troops carried short swords of this kind right through, and they were only gradually displaced by the longer sword around the year 500, so the weapon overlaps in time with 588. The instruments that really decided the fighting at Langbi were the ships. The great warships Yang Su built at Yong'an, named the Wuya, carried five tiers of decks a hundred feet and more in height, with six raking poles fore and aft and to the sides, fifty feet tall, taking eight hundred fighting men, and banners flying above; next came the Huanglong, carrying a hundred men each, and then the flat-bottomed Pingcheng and the light Sanghuang in lesser sizes. The Chen answered with more than a hundred Azure Dragon ships holding the beach. The weapons of the shore fighting were the Sui ring-pommel sabres, long spears and armoured cavalry against the Chen crossbows and long shafts; the Sui later rammed Chen hulls with pine spars, and the chain across the river was undone by taking the camp on the bank first and only then removing the chain. The short blade thus appears in this battle only in the scattered hand-to-hand struggles inside the palisades, and is not the pivot of the outcome.
tactics: 楊素此役的戰法是夜渡奪灘、三面合擊。先以舟師自永安溯流而上，避開白日下船之弊：若敵先見我舟，灘流迅急，進退便不能自主。故全軍銜枚夜行，楊素親率黃龍數千艘順流而下，直趨狼尾灘；同時分兵兩路，開府王長襲引步卒自南岸攻擊戚欣的別柵，大將軍劉仁恩率甲騎取白沙北岸，約定遲明而至，待天明三面合擊，戚欣敗走。得手之後，隋軍不誣不虐，悉虜其眾而遣之，秋毫無犯，陳人因此心服，灘頭的抵抗隨之瓦解。續戰之時，隋軍面對岐亭鐵鎖，又採取先登岸、先攻柵，敵軍夜潰後徐徐去鎖的次序，不急於硬撞鐵索；至荊門延洲，以五牙四艘配柏檣撞碎敵艦十餘艘，俘甲士二千餘人。水戰、登岸、攻柵、撞船四種手段在此役串成一條完整程序，火炬照明與旗鼓只在合擊那一刻才用得上。銜枚夜行最要緊處在於禁聲：不張火號、不鳴鼓角，只靠事先約定的遲明時辰三面合擊，時辰一錯，舟影便會先被敵人看見。楊素自坐平乘大船居中指揮，以旗鼓統一三路時序，陳人遠望其容貌雄偉，懼而稱之為江神。
tacticsEn: Yang Su's method in this battle was a night crossing to seize the beach, followed by a three-sided stroke. The flotilla first pushed up the river from Yong'an, avoiding the disadvantage of landing by day: if the enemy saw his ships first, the current at the beach ran so swiftly that nothing could be controlled. So the whole force went by night with the crews gagged, Yang Su himself leading several thousand Huanglong ships down the current straight for Langbi, while the army was split into two wings: the Held Secretary Wang Changxiang took infantry from the south bank against the separate camp of Qi Xin, and the General Liu Renen took armoured cavalry by the north bank at Baisha, both to arrive at daybreak, and the three attacks fell together at dawn and Qi Xin was routed. Once the beach was won the Sui did not abuse the prisoners: they took the whole body of men and sent them away, touching nothing of theirs, and the Chen people were won over, and the resistance at the beach fell away with them. In the fighting that followed, facing the chain across the river at Qiting, the Sui again took their turns in order: they landed first and attacked the camp, and only when the enemy broke by night did they remove the chain at leisure, in no hurry to ram the iron; and at Yanzhou of Jingmen they sent four Wuya with pine spars to shatter a dozen enemy ships, taking more than two thousand armoured men prisoner. Battle by water, landing, assault on the palisade and ramming of ships are strung together here into one complete sequence, and torches and drums came into use only at the moment of the combined assault.
data: 《隋書·楊素傳》記楊素所造五牙大艦樓五層、高百餘尺，左右前後置六拍竿、並高五十尺，容戰士八百人；次曰黃龍，置兵百人；平乘、舴艋等各有差等。交戰雙方船數：隋軍楊素親率黃龍數千艘，陳將戚欣以青龍戰船百餘艘、屯兵數千守狼尾灘，具體兵員各書未細分，兩家船數相差約一個數量級，沉沒與焚毀的船隻各書無明文。擊潰之後，隋軍悉虜陳軍眾而遣之，數目無明文，只見「秋毫無犯，陳人大悅」的記載。地理上，狼尾灘在流頭灘附近，屬三峽巫峽一段，楊素由永安（今湖北興山、秭歸一帶）溯流而入，水路約數十里，逆水行舟故全軍銜枚夜渡。時間上，開皇八年十一月隋主分八道發兵，晉王廣為行軍元帥，《資治通鑑》記隋軍總兵五十一萬八千人，《隋書》記楊廣所領東路為五萬一千人、自採石濟江，兩說皆把後勤預備計入，實際作戰與首批渡江之數遠少於此；十二月楊素舟師入三峽、戰於狼尾灘；開皇九年正月，先後有岐亭鐵鎖與荊州恆豐之戰，隋軍傷亡慘重、死五千餘人，隨後楊素克江陵；同一月楊廣東路亦入建康，陳亡。
dataEn: The History of Sui records that the great Wuya built by Yang Su carried five tiers of decks a hundred feet and more in height, with six raking poles fore and aft and to the sides, fifty feet tall, taking eight hundred fighting men; that the Huanglong next in order carried a hundred men each; and that the flat-bottomed Pingcheng and the light Sanghuang came in lesser sizes. On the numbers of ships on both sides: Yang Su led several thousand Huanglong personally, while the Chen general Qi Xin held Langbi with more than a hundred Azure Dragon warships and several thousand men, and the books do not break the crews down further. After the rout the Sui took the whole body of Chen men and sent them away, and no number is given, only the record that not the least thing of theirs was touched and the Chen people were glad. As to geography, Langbi lies near Liutou beach in the Wu Gorge stretch of the Three Gorges; Yang Su came up from Yong'an, in the modern counties of Xingshan and Zigui in Hubei, a matter of some tens of li of water, and because the boats were going against the current the whole force crossed by night with the crews gagged. As to timing: in the eleventh month of the eighth year of Kaihuang the Sui ruler sent the eight columns out, with Prince Yang Guang as supreme commander; the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance gives a total of 518,000 men, while the History of Sui gives 51,100 for the eastern route under Yang Guang, crossing at Caishi, and both counts fold logistics and reserves in, so the men actually fighting and the first troops across were far fewer. In the twelfth month Yang Su's flotilla entered the Gorges and fought at Langbi; in the first month of Kaihuang 9 came the chain at Qiting and then the battle of Hengfeng in Jingzhou, in which the Sui suffered heavily, with more than five thousand dead, and Yang Su then took Jiangling. In that same month the eastern column under Yang Guang entered Jiankang, and the Chen were finished.
cause: 隋滅陳是南北分裂的最後一段收束。開皇年間隋已平齊統一北方，倉廩充盈，府兵與糧秣調度有餘，遂於開皇八年冬大舉南征：分八道進兵，楊廣領東路取採石、姑孰，楊素領舟師自永安入三峽，韓擒虎趨廬州，賀若弼指向京口，意圖三路並進，一舉滅陳。楊素早在信州任上就屢進取陳之策，且在永安預造五牙、黃龍等大艦，為逆水而上預先備好舟師。陳朝的局面則是疆域日狹、兵力分散、各守一段：荊州刺史陳慧紀當江陵之線，狼尾灘交由戚欣獨守，岐亭由呂仲肅綴鎖橫江，建康一線則倚長江天險與大將蕭摩訶，卻屢不聽其出戰之請。隋軍看準陳防線的分段與各自為戰，選擇在陳以為天險可恃的冬季上游灘頭發動奇襲，一舉扭轉被動。
causeEn: The destruction of the Chen by the Sui was the closing of the last stretch of the division between north and south. In the Kaihuang era the Sui had already destroyed Northern Qi and unified the north, with full granaries and a militia and grain system able to shift supplies at will, so in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang a great invasion of the south was launched in eight columns. Yang Guang took the eastern route toward Caishi and Guushu, Yang Su led the flotilla from Yong'an into the Three Gorges, Han Qinhu moved against Luzhou and He Ruobi pointed at Jingkou, the intention being to advance in three lines at once and destroy the Chen in a single stroke. Yang Su had been pressing his own schemes for taking the Chen while he was still administrator of Xinzhou, and at Yong'an he had the great ships, the Wuya and the Huanglong, built in advance, so that a fleet would be ready for the push against the current. The Chen, meanwhile, saw its territory shrink, its soldiers scattered, and every stretch of the river held separately: the Inspector of Jingzhou, Chen Huiji, took the line at Jiangling; the beach at Langbi was entrusted to Qi Xin alone; at Qiting Lü Zhongsu chained the river with iron; and the line at Jiankang rested on the natural barrier of the Yangtze and on the great commander Xiao Mohe, whose request to attack was repeatedly refused. The Sui saw the divided Chen defence and the lack of common command, and chose to strike by surprise at an upstream beach in midwinter, in the very season when the Chen trusted the river to hold them.
impact: 狼尾灘之役是隋滅陳的西線樞紐。此戰之後，隋軍取得三峽與流頭灘，陳的長江上游防線崩解，荊州與江陵的門戶洞開，開皇九年正月楊素遂克江陵，陳失荊襄之地；同一月楊廣東路韓擒虎自廬州趨建康、賀若弼渡京口，陳後主被俘，陳朝覆亡，南北分裂至此結束。隋軍在灘頭悉虜其眾而遣之、秋毫無犯的做法，對江南民心有實際作用，陳軍人心隨之瓦解，加速了陳朝崩潰。自此長江天險不再是陳朝的屏障，江北的兵馬可直抵建康城下，數百年的南北分界在兩個月內被抹去。其後隋朝開皇之治把制度推向極盛，但此役亦顯示出代價：隋以傾國之力興兵，連年用兵、營造東都、開鑿運河、三征高句麗，國力迅速耗盡，仁壽末年已伏下二世而亡的危機。就兵器史而言，這是一場以艦船與灘頭工事決定勝負的水陸戰，而與之同時，歐洲的羅馬短劍正逐漸讓位於長劍，兩個文明在各自的接觸面上走向新的兵刃形態。
impactEn: The battle of Langbi was the hinge of the Sui conquest of the Chen on the western front. After it the Sui held the Three Gorges and Liutou beach, the Chen's upper river defence collapsed, and the gates of Jingzhou and Jiangling stood open, so that in the first month of Kaihuang 9 Yang Su took Jiangling and the Chen lost Jing and Xiang. In the same month, on the eastern front, Han Qinhu raced from Luzhou to Jiankang and He Ruobi crossed at Jingkou, the Chen ruler was taken prisoner, the Chen were destroyed, and the division between north and south came to an end. The Sui practice of taking the whole body of men at the beach and sending them away, touching nothing of theirs, had a real effect on the people of the south, and the Chen troops' morale went with it, hastening the collapse of the dynasty. From that day the Yangtze was no longer a shield to the Chen, and troops from the north could ride straight to the walls of Jiankang, and a division of some centuries was rubbed out within two months. The Kaihuang prosperity that followed carried the Sui institutions to their height, but this battle also showed the cost: the Sui had raised the whole country in arms, campaigned year after year, built the eastern capital, cut the Grand Canal and made three invasions of Goguryeo, and drained the state so quickly that the crisis leading to the dynasty's early death was already visible in the last years of Renshou. In the history of weapons this was a war of water and land decided by warships and by works on the beach, and at the same time in Europe the Roman short sword was giving way to the longer sword, two civilizations moving toward new forms of blade on their own contact faces.
result: 結果是隋軍完勝。戚欣所部於狼尾灘潰敗，戚欣敗走，隋軍悉虜其眾、勞而遣之，流頭灘與狼尾灘落入隋軍之手，楊素遂率水軍東下，舟艫被江、旌甲曜日，陳人望之懼，稱「清河公即江神」。陳方荊州方向的抵抗隨之瓦解：呂仲肅屯岐亭、綴鐵鎖三條橫截上流，仍被楊素與劉仁恩登陸攻柵所破，兵潰後退保荊門延洲，終被隋軍以五牙四艘配柏檣撞碎敵艦、俘甲士二千餘人，僅以身免。開皇九年正月楊素克江陵，隋軍控制荊州，與東路楊廣部形成南北夾擊；同月建康陷落、陳後主被俘，陳朝正式滅亡，蕭摩訶隨主降隋。狼尾灘那一夜夜間渡江與遲明合擊，決定了長江中游的門戶，也把隋朝推向統一，而這個統一帶來的巨大消耗，日後又在同一條江上以另一種形式出現。
resultEn: The result was a complete Sui victory. Qi Xin's command broke at Langbi and Qi Xin fled; the Sui took the whole body of his men and sent them away relieved of harm, and Liutou beach and Langbi fell into Sui hands. Yang Su then led his water force east, the hulls covering the river and the banners and armour making the sun dim, and the Chen, seeing him, were afraid and said that the Duke of Qinghe was the god of the river. The Chen resistance on the Jingzhou front collapsed with it: Lü Zhongsu, posted at Qiting with three iron chains across the upper river, was still broken when Yang Su and Liu Renen landed and attacked the camp, and after his troops broke by night he fell back to Yanzhou of Jingmen, only to be overwhelmed when the Sui sent four Wuya with pine spars to shatter his ships and took more than two thousand armoured men prisoner, so that he escaped with his life alone. In the first month of Kaihuang 9 Yang Su took Jiangling, the Sui held Jingzhou, and the Sui armies closed on the Chen from north and south; in the same month Jiankang fell, the Chen ruler was taken prisoner, the Chen were formally destroyed, and Xiao Mohe surrendered with his master. That night crossing of the beach at Langbi, with the wings falling together at daybreak, decided the gate of the middle river and carried the Sui toward unification, and the enormous strain of that unification was to return to the same river later in another shape.
